svg.aria-label: Wiring: charge contacts through a reverse-polarity diode to the BQ25100 charger and the curved cell; a 3.0 V regulator feeds the ANNA-B402 module and sensors; the IQS7211E touch controller, LIS2DW12 accelerometer and optional MAX30102 share one I2C bus with their interrupt lines on module GPIOs; the slider segments sit on the outer face of the flex.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
